title_en: In Brightest Day or Blackest Night, Your Collection Will Shine With These Exclusive Green Lantern Funko Pop! Figures
summary_en: IGN can exclusively reveal Funko's exclusive DC Pop! figures for NYCC, featuring Hal Jordan in a number of different Lantern costumes.
body_en:
New York Comic-Con is right around the corner, which means it's time for companies like Funko to reveal the exclusive collectibles they'll be selling at the show. Funko Pop! collectors have a very Green Lantern-heavy lineup to look forward to this year, as the company has an exclusive and very colorful lineup of Hal Jordan figures planned.
Check out the slideshow gallery below to see all of these multi-colored Lanterns, and read on to learn how you can buy them yourself:
All of these Funko Pop! Hal Jordan figures will be sold exclusively at Funko's booth (#4515), with limited quantities of certain figures being offered online later on Funko Web . While the standard Green Lantern version will be available each day of the con, the rest are only being sold on one specific day. Details below:
Price: $40
Quantity: 2000 units
Availability: Thursday 10/8 through Sunday 10/11
Price: $40
Quantity: 1000 units

Price: $50

Price: $60

Price: $60

Availability: Sunday 10/11
Previous Funko reveals include the SDCC-exclusive Invincible Funko Pop! figures and the Street Fighter movie Funko line .
